author: Dear_Madelene
body: I still on step one lol, and I play every day, doing gauntlets and walking around. It certainly annoying, not gonna lie. I hope this elusive quest mobs are somewhere out there, waiting for me... But if not, so be it, you can't really fight with rng and bad game design.

author: Azzydabomb
body: Maybe it's rng but I've done maybe 20 dungeons a day plus my own gauntlet when it resets at t8 an I've easily had 80 celestial sundrops and 50 moondrops, I'm going into the dungeons in full luck gear mind! Just to try and maximise my drop chance when I do see one of the mobs

author: Hadeshorne
body:
The fastest way to complete the 2nd quest is going to be doing it in t7/8 party dungeons, or getting someone to share a bunch of the event raids with you.

It's not a very friendly event for players to do it alone.

author: drag96mal
body: I think is lucky try running gauntlets t7 and t8 with the dowsing rot it helps a lot I'm half way 15 of 30 even with some mobs not dropping items

author: Real_Jest
body: The devs of this game doesn't really know how to do events properly tbh. If they didn't notify you that there's an event going on, you might not even know it's happening just coz you very rarely see the mobs from it.

author: Darren-G
body: I'm ok with slow progress if I *know* that it is slow progress. What I find hard is the nagging feeling that the month is ticking by and I might have overlooked something and be barking up the wrong tree...

author: Apprehensive-Nose646
body:
I feel like I'm averaging about 1.5 spawns per t10 mystic cave and about 0.5 spawns per t8 dungeon. 

But those numbers are made worse by low drop rates. It took me a bit before I stubbornly switched over from my usual exp/orn farming gear over to luck rate gear.

My big thing is I still don't know if I want the pets. Maybe I just want to use  all the drops to summon raids and bosses. 

Does anyone know what "lesser wall" spells do?

author: NeonRei
body:
30 days, and like most events, it seems that the spawn rates increase toward the end of the event. 

It is a grind tho, and this game really is a grind like many others. 

I did about 20 dungeons and only got a total of 3. And I'm doing t11 dungeons with 25 levels. It's a drag but gotta grind for multiple reasons, like mats, orns and XP for it to feel worth the time imo.

Hang in

author: petr1petr
body:
for stardrops, go T7 dungeons - it drops from T6, T7 and T7 monsters

for moondrops, go horde mystic or T8 dungeons - it drops from T8 and T10 monster

it should also drop from bosses/raids that you can summon by stardrops and moondrops, but I had no luck with 2 bosses, so I quit that and I had not tested raid yet..

it took me few days of going to/from office by bus to complete the quests.. 

It is month long event, so it is ok, to have slower progress..

author: Drunkturtle7
body: You have like 26 more days to finish it.

body: Idk man, I've seen plenty and haven't even run many gauntlets, I see at least one per, pretty decent spawn rate imo, it's only what like the second day, I'm like 12-15 gauntlets in and already have 10 of the blue and 15 of the yellow stones, I only make it to like 120 on endless but usually see 2-3 each, if you haven't given endless gauntlets a go maybe try those and see if it helps your luck
